preconditions.description: The board dimensions n and m must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '.wb' for row in board for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the board must be either '.', 'w', or 'b'.

preconditions.expression: len(board) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: The board must have exactly n rows, each of length m.

postconditions.description: If tiling is possible, the output must start with 'YES' followed by n lines of tiling.
If tiling is impossible, the output must be 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '.abcd' for row in tiling for c in row)
postconditions.description: The tiling must only contain '.', 'a', 'b', 'c', or 'd'.
